title: S5. Within–between temperature models
text:
This second temperature formulation is reported in the main paper alongside the single-temperature model. It separates the association of a female’s warmer-than-usual breeding attempts from differences between females with different observed thermal histories. Temperature is split in both location and scale; continuous year, laying date, age and existing random-effect structures are retained.

d$temp_within <- d$temp_mean_c - d$temp_between

title: S5. Within–between temperature models
text:
Fit the within–between models
Clutch size uses COM-Poisson; fledging success uses zero-inflated beta-binomial. The extra-zero equation retains an intercept and year random effect, without temperature slopes.


Show fitting script (run locally)



R/90_fit_temperature_within_between.R

# Separate supplementary temperature within/between models, 26 October 2026.
# The original fits/exports are read-only. Public model-ready inputs are in
# data_derived/analysis; regenerated fitted objects stay under models/.
.libPaths(c(".Rlib", .libPaths()))
Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = 1, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = 1)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(glmmTMB))

run_within_between <- function(clutch_csv, reproduction_csv) {
  model_dir <- Sys.getenv("WB_MODEL_DIR", "models/within_between_20261026")
  output <- paste0("tables/within_between_20261026", Sys.getenv("WB_OUTPUT_SUFFIX", "_reproduced"))
  dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(output, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  put <- function(x, name) write.csv(x, file.path(output, name), row.names = FALSE)
  message_now <- function(...) {
    cat(format(Sys.time()), ..., "\n"); flush.console()
  }
  original_hashes <- tools::md5sum(c(
    "tables/final_models_20261019/count_coefficients.csv",
    "tables/primary_ZIyear_ML_20261021/ZIyear_fixed.csv"))
  clutch <- read.csv(clutch_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  reproductive <- read.csv(reproduction_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  fledging <- subset(reproductive, year <= 2019 & !is.na(fledged) &
                       age_class %in% c("YOUNG", "OLD") &
                       !is.na(female_id) & female_id != "" & !is.na(rel_LD))
  fledging$rel_LD <- fledging$laying_date -
    ave(fledging$laying_date, fledging$year, FUN = median)
  fledging$temp_mean_c <- fledging$temp_mean - mean(fledging$temp_mean)
  fledging$year_c <- fledging$year - mean(fledging$year)
  clutch$year <- as.integer(as.character(clutch$year_f))
  datasets <- list(clutch = clutch, fledging = fledging)
  requested <- strsplit(Sys.getenv("WB_TRAITS", "clutch,fledging"), ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  stopifnot(all(requested %in% names(datasets)))
  datasets <- datasets[requested]
  reference <- read.csv("tables/temporal_models_20261022/observed_annual.csv")
  old_clutch <- read.csv("tables/final_models_20261019/count_coefficients.csv")
  old_clutch <- subset(old_clutch, model == "COM_Poisson")
  old_fledging <- read.csv("tables/primary_ZIyear_ML_20261021/ZIyear_fixed.csv")
  diagnostics <- fixed <- contrasts <- comparisons <- metadata <- vifs <- list()

  diagrow <- function(m, trait, model, optimizer) {
    gradient <- tryCatch(m$sdr$gradient.fixed, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    se <- tryCatch(sqrt(diag(m$sdr$cov.fixed)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
    data.frame(trait = trait, model = model, optimizer = optimizer,
               n = nobs(m), parameters = attr(logLik(m), "df"),
               logLik = as.numeric(logLik(m)), AIC = AIC(m),
               convergence = m$fit$convergence, pdHess = isTRUE(m$sdr$pdHess),
               scaled_gradient = max(abs(gradient * se)))
  }
  good <- function(m) {
    z <- diagrow(m, "", "", "")
    isTRUE(z$convergence == 0 && z$pdHess && is.finite(z$logLik) &&
             is.finite(z$scaled_gradient) && z$scaled_gradient < .005)
  }
  start_from <- function(m) {
    pl <- m$obj$env$parList(par = m$fit$parfull)
    st <- pl[intersect(c("beta", "betazi", "betadisp", "theta", "thetazi",
                        "thetadisp", "b", "bzi", "bdisp", "psi"), names(pl))]
    st[lengths(st) > 0]
  }
  whitened <- function(par, fn, gr, control = list(), ...) {
    if (trait == "clutch") {
      inner <- environment(fn)$inner.control
      inner$maxit <- 100L; inner$grad.tol <- 1e-7
      environment(fn)$inner.control <- inner
    }
    # Reuse the already computed Hessian inverse at the first optimiser's
    # solution for coordinate scaling, rather than computing it twice.
    # Optimisation still uses the unbounded, exact marginal likelihood.
    V <- a$sdr$cov.fixed
    stopifnot(nrow(V) == length(par), all(is.finite(V)))
    eig <- eigen((V + t(V)) / 2, symmetric = TRUE)
    stopifnot(min(eig$values) > 0)
    S <- eig$vectors %*% diag(sqrt(eig$values))
    initial <- par
    ff <- function(q) fn(drop(initial + S %*% q))
    gg <- function(q) drop(crossprod(S, gr(drop(initial + S %*% q))))
    if (trait == "clutch" && kind == "within_between") {
      fit <- nlminb(rep(0, length(par)), ff, gg,
                    control = list(iter.max = 1500, eval.max = 3000, rel.tol = 1e-11, trace = 1))
      fit$value <- fit$objective
    } else fit <- optim(rep(0, length(par)), ff, gg, method = "BFGS",
                        control = list(maxit = 1500, reltol = 1e-12))
    list(par = drop(initial + S %*% fit$par), objective = fit$value,
         convergence = fit$convergence, message = fit$message)
  }

  expanded_bfgs <- function(par, fn, gr, control = list(), ...) {
    # Lift baseline covariance to the expanded model and add independent
    # numerical scales for the two new contrasts. These are step scales,
    # not priors or restrictions on coefficients.
    inner <- environment(fn)$inner.control
    inner$maxit <- 100L; inner$grad.tol <- 1e-7
    environment(fn)$inner.control <- inner
    old_names <- rownames(fits$baseline$sdr$cov.fixed)
    A <- matrix(0, length(par), length(old_names))
    C <- matrix(0, length(par), 2)
    for (g in c("beta", "betadisp", "theta")) {
      ni <- which(names(par) == g); oi <- which(old_names == g)
      if (g == "theta") A[cbind(ni, oi)] <- 1 else {
        mapped <- match(sub("temp_(within|between)", "temp_mean_c", active_columns), columns)
        A[cbind(ni, oi[mapped])] <- 1
        C[ni[active_columns == "temp_within"], if (g == "beta") 1 else 2] <- .5
        C[ni[active_columns == "temp_between"], if (g == "beta") 1 else 2] <- -.5
      }
    }
    V <- A %*% fits$baseline$sdr$cov.fixed %*% t(A) +
      C %*% diag(c(.01^2, .05^2)) %*% t(C)
    e <- eigen((V + t(V))/2, symmetric = TRUE)
    stopifnot(min(e$values) > 0)
    S <- e$vectors %*% diag(sqrt(e$values))
    ff <- function(q) fn(drop(par + S %*% q))
    gg <- function(q) drop(crossprod(S, gr(drop(par + S %*% q))))
    z <- optim(rep(0, length(par)), ff, gg, method = "BFGS",
               control = list(maxit = 1500, reltol = 1e-11, trace = 1, REPORT = 10))
    list(par = drop(par + S %*% z$par), objective = z$value,
         convergence = z$convergence, message = z$message)
  }

  for (trait in names(datasets)) {
    message_now("START", trait)
    d <- datasets[[trait]]
    d$female_id <- factor(d$female_id)
    d$year_f <- factor(d$year)
    d$age_class <- factor(d$age_class, levels = c("YOUNG", "OLD"))
    obs <- reference[reference$trait == trait, ]
    counts <- table(d$year)
    stopifnot(length(counts) == nrow(obs),
              all(as.integer(counts[as.character(obs$year)]) == obs$n),
              max(abs(tapply(d$rel_LD, d$year, mean)[as.character(obs$year)] -
                        obs$mean_relative_date)) < 1e-10,
              max(abs(tapply(d$age_class == "OLD", d$year, mean)[as.character(obs$year)] -
                        obs$older_fraction)) < 1e-10)
    temperature_center <- unique(round(d$temp_mean - d$temp_mean_c, 10))
    stopifnot(length(temperature_center) == 1)
    d$temp_between <- ave(d$temp_mean, d$female_id, FUN = mean) - temperature_center
    d$temp_within <- d$temp_mean_c - d$temp_between
    stopifnot(max(abs(d$temp_within + d$temp_between - d$temp_mean_c)) < 1e-10,
              max(abs(tapply(d$temp_within, d$female_id, mean))) < 1e-8)
    groups <- split(d$temp_mean, d$female_id)
    varied <- vapply(groups, function(x) length(unique(round(x, 10))) > 1, logical(1))
    metadata[[trait]] <- data.frame(
      trait = trait, records = nrow(d), females = nlevels(d$female_id),
      seasons = nlevels(d$year_f), females_repeated = sum(lengths(groups) >= 2),
      females_varied_temperature = sum(varied),
      records_in_varied_temperature_females = sum(lengths(groups)[varied]),
      temperature_center = temperature_center,
      year_center = unique(round(d$year - d$year_c, 8)))
    saveRDS(d, file.path(model_dir, paste0(trait, "_analysis_data.rds")))

    base_form <- if (trait == "clutch")
      clutch ~ rel_LD + temp_mean_c + year_c + age_class + (1 | female_id) + (1 | year_f) else
      cbind(fledged, clutch - fledged) ~ rel_LD + age_class + temp_mean_c + year_c +
        (1 | female_id) + (1 | year_f)
    wb_form <- if (trait == "clutch")
      clutch ~ rel_LD + temp_within + temp_between + year_c + age_class +
        (1 | female_id) + (1 | year_f) else
      cbind(fledged, clutch - fledged) ~ rel_LD + age_class + temp_within + temp_between +
        year_c + (1 | female_id) + (1 | year_f)
    base_disp <- if (trait == "clutch") ~ rel_LD + temp_mean_c + year_c + age_class else
      ~ rel_LD + age_class + temp_mean_c + year_c + (1 | year_f)
    wb_disp <- if (trait == "clutch") ~ rel_LD + temp_within + temp_between + year_c + age_class else
      ~ rel_LD + age_class + temp_within + temp_between + year_c + (1 | year_f)
    base_fixed <- if (trait == "clutch") ~ rel_LD + temp_mean_c + year_c + age_class else
      ~ rel_LD + age_class + temp_mean_c + year_c
    wb_fixed <- if (trait == "clutch") ~ rel_LD + temp_within + temp_between + year_c + age_class else
      ~ rel_LD + age_class + temp_within + temp_between + year_c
    columns <- colnames(model.matrix(base_fixed, d))
    old <- if (trait == "clutch") old_clutch else old_fledging
    get_cf <- function(component) {
      z <- old[old$component == component, ]; setNames(z$estimate, z$term)
    }
    st <- list(beta = unname(get_cf("cond")[columns]),
               betadisp = unname(get_cf("disp")[columns]))
    if (trait == "clutch") {
      st$theta <- log(c(.06028, .02186))
      # Quasi-IRLS is only a starting-mode calculation. The actual likelihood,
      # gradients and Hessian are still computed by the exact COM-Poisson model.
      nf <- nlevels(d$female_id); ny <- nlevels(d$year_f); n <- nrow(d)
      Z <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = rep(seq_len(n), 2),
        j = c(as.integer(d$female_id), nf + as.integer(d$year_f)), x = 1,
        dims = c(n, nf + ny))
      Q <- Matrix::Diagonal(x = c(rep(1 / .06028^2, nf), rep(1 / .02186^2, ny)))
      eta0 <- drop(model.matrix(base_fixed, d) %*% st$beta)
      phi0 <- exp(drop(model.matrix(base_fixed, d) %*% st$betadisp))
      modes <- rep(0, nf + ny)
      for (initial_iteration in 1:20) {
        eta <- eta0 + as.numeric(Z %*% modes); mu <- exp(eta)
        variance <- pmax(mu * phi0 + .5 * phi0 * (1 - phi0), .1 * mu * phi0)
        weights <- mu^2 / variance
        working <- eta - eta0 + (d$clutch - mu) / mu
        H <- Matrix::crossprod(Z, Matrix::Diagonal(x = weights) %*% Z) + Q
        next_modes <- as.numeric(Matrix::solve(H, Matrix::crossprod(Z, weights * working)))
        change <- max(abs(next_modes - modes)); modes <- next_modes
        if (change < 1e-8) break
      }
      st$b <- modes
      message_now(trait, "starting modes prepared", initial_iteration, "iterations")
    } else {
      st$betazi <- unname(get_cf("zi")["(Intercept)"])
      st$theta <- log(c(.30025823943742, .309608546517611))
      st$thetazi <- log(.526058431521361)
      st$thetadisp <- log(.249035787139773)
    }
    # Scaled numerical bounds stabilise the initial searches. A second,
    # unbounded optimiser checks every fit. The expanded clutch model uses
    # covariance-scaled BFGS followed by nlminb instead of the bounded search.
    active_columns <- columns
    bounded <- function(par, fn, gr, control = list(), ...) {
      if (trait == "clutch") {
        inner <- environment(fn)$inner.control
        inner$maxit <- 100L; inner$grad.tol <- 1e-7
        environment(fn)$inner.control <- inner
      }
      lower <- rep(-10, length(par)); upper <- rep(10, length(par))
      scale <- rep(1, length(par))
      for (component in c("beta", "betadisp")) {
        ix <- which(names(par) == component)
        stopifnot(length(ix) == length(active_columns))
        scale[ix[active_columns == "rel_LD"]] <- .01
        scale[ix[active_columns == "year_c"]] <- .005
        scale[ix[grepl("^temp_", active_columns)]] <- .1
        scale[ix[active_columns == "age_classOLD"]] <- .1
        if (trait == "clutch") {
          lower[ix] <- if (component == "beta") -.2 else -.5
          upper[ix] <- if (component == "beta") .2 else .5
          lower[ix[active_columns == "(Intercept)"]] <- if (component == "beta") 1.6 else -5
          upper[ix[active_columns == "(Intercept)"]] <- if (component == "beta") 2 else 0
        }
      }
      re <- grepl("^theta", names(par))
      lower[re] <- -10; upper[re] <- log(5)
      opt <- optim(par, fn, gr, method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = lower, upper = upper,
                   control = list(maxit = 3000, factr = 1e4, pgtol = 1e-7,
                                  parscale = scale, trace = 1, REPORT = 10))
      list(par = opt$par, objective = opt$value, convergence = opt$convergence,
           message = opt$message)
    }
    fits <- list()
    for (kind in c("baseline", "within_between")) {
      special <- trait == "clutch" && kind == "within_between"
      first_label <- if (special) "expanded_BFGS" else "LBFGSB"
      second_label <- if (special) "whitened_NLMINB" else "BFGS"
      first_file <- file.path(model_dir, paste0(trait, "_", kind, "_", first_label, ".rds"))
      message_now(trait, kind, first_label)
      if (file.exists(first_file)) a <- readRDS(first_file) else {
        if (kind == "baseline") {
          a <- glmmTMB(base_form, dispformula = base_disp,
                       ziformula = if (trait == "clutch") ~ 0 else ~ 1 + (1 | year_f),
                       family = if (trait == "clutch") compois() else betabinomial(),
                       data = d, start = st,
                       control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = bounded, parallel = 4))
        } else {
          prior <- fits$baseline; new_start <- start_from(prior)
          old_cf <- fixef(prior); wb_columns <- colnames(model.matrix(wb_fixed, d))
          duplicate_temperature <- function(v) {
            v["temp_within"] <- v["temp_mean_c"]
            v["temp_between"] <- v["temp_mean_c"]
            unname(v[wb_columns])
          }
          active_columns <- wb_columns
          new_start$beta <- duplicate_temperature(old_cf$cond)
          new_start$betadisp <- duplicate_temperature(old_cf$disp)
          a <- update(prior, formula = wb_form, dispformula = wb_disp, data = d,
                      start = new_start,
                      control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = if (special) expanded_bfgs else bounded, parallel = 4))
        }
        saveRDS(a, first_file)
      }
      print(diagrow(a, trait, kind, first_label))
      second_file <- file.path(model_dir, paste0(trait, "_", kind, "_", second_label, ".rds"))
      message_now(trait, kind, "independent refinement", second_label)
      if (file.exists(second_file)) b <- readRDS(second_file) else {
        b <- update(a, data = d, start = start_from(a),
                    control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = whitened, parallel = 4))
        saveRDS(b, second_file)
      }
      print(diagrow(b, trait, kind, second_label))
      diagnostics[[paste(trait, kind)]] <- rbind(diagrow(a, trait, kind, first_label),
                                               diagrow(b, trait, kind, second_label))
      put(do.call(rbind, diagnostics), "optimizer_comparison.csv")
      ok <- vapply(list(a, b), good, logical(1))
      if (!any(ok)) stop("No admissible model: ", trait, " ", kind)
      candidates <- list(a, b)[ok]
      selected <- candidates[[which.max(vapply(candidates, function(m) as.numeric(logLik(m)), numeric(1)))]]
      fits[[kind]] <- selected
      saveRDS(selected, file.path(model_dir, paste0(trait, "_", kind, "_selected.rds")))
      capture.output(summary(selected), file=file.path(output,paste0(trait,"_",kind,"_summary.txt")))
      if (kind == "baseline") {
        expected <- if (trait == "clutch") -13768.5520704332 else -16632.056176958
        difference <- as.numeric(logLik(selected)) - expected
        message_now(trait, "baseline logLik minus original", difference)
        stopifnot(abs(difference) < .001)
      }
      cf <- summary(selected)$coefficients
      fixed[[paste(trait, kind)]] <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(cf), function(component) {
        x <- cf[[component]]
        if (is.null(dim(x)) || nrow(x) == 0L) return(NULL)
        data.frame(trait = trait, model = kind, component = component, term = rownames(x),
                   estimate = x[, 1], SE = x[, 2], lower = x[, 1] - qnorm(.975) * x[, 2],
                   upper = x[, 1] + qnorm(.975) * x[, 2])
      }))
      put(do.call(rbind, fixed), "fixed_effects.csv")
    }
    m <- fits$within_between
    for (component in c("cond", "disp")) {
      cf <- fixef(m)[[component]]; V <- vcov(m)[[component]]
      L <- setNames(rep(0, length(cf)), names(cf))
      L["temp_within"] <- 1; L["temp_between"] <- -1
      estimate <- sum(L * cf); se <- sqrt(drop(t(L) %*% V %*% L))
      contrasts[[paste(trait, component)]] <- data.frame(
        trait = trait, component = component, contrast = "within_minus_between",
        estimate = estimate, SE = se, lower = estimate - qnorm(.975) * se,
        upper = estimate + qnorm(.975) * se, p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(estimate / se)))
    }
    LR <- 2 * (as.numeric(logLik(m)) - as.numeric(logLik(fits$baseline)))
    df <- attr(logLik(m), "df") - attr(logLik(fits$baseline), "df")
    comparisons[[trait]] <- data.frame(
      trait = trait, baseline_AIC = AIC(fits$baseline), within_between_AIC = AIC(m),
      delta_AIC = AIC(m) - AIC(fits$baseline), LR = LR, df = df,
      p = pchisq(LR, df, lower.tail = FALSE))
    X <- model.matrix(wb_fixed, d); Z <- X[, colnames(X) != "(Intercept)"]
    stopifnot(qr(X)$rank == ncol(X))
    vif <- vapply(seq_len(ncol(Z)), function(j)
      1 / (1 - summary(lm(Z[, j] ~ Z[, -j, drop = FALSE]))$r.squared), numeric(1))
    vifs[[trait]] <- data.frame(trait = trait, predictor = colnames(Z), VIF = vif)
    put(do.call(rbind, metadata), "sample_metadata.csv")
    put(do.call(rbind, contrasts), "within_between_contrasts.csv")
    put(do.call(rbind, comparisons), "model_comparison.csv")
    put(do.call(rbind, vifs), "fixed_design_vif.csv")
    capture.output(sessionInfo(), file = file.path(output, "session_info.txt"))
    message_now("FINISHED", trait)
  }
  stopifnot(identical(original_hashes, tools::md5sum(names(original_hashes))))
  message_now("COMPLETE: original models and exports unchanged")
}

cmp_pmf <- function(mu, phi) {
  nu <- 1 / phi; k <- 0:max(40, ceiling(max(mu) + 20)); lf <- lgamma(k + 1)
  prob <- function(a) {
    z <- outer(a, k) - outer(nu, lf)
    z <- exp(z - do.call(pmax, as.data.frame(z)))
    z / rowSums(z)
  }
  lo <- nu * log(pmax(mu - 3, .001)) - 20
  hi <- nu * log(mu + 3) + 20
  for (i in 1:65) {
    mid <- (lo + hi) / 2; p <- prob(mid); low <- drop(p %*% k) < mu
    lo[low] <- mid[low]; hi[!low] <- mid[!low]
  }
  p <- prob((lo + hi) / 2)
  stopifnot(max(abs(drop(p %*% k) - mu)) < 1e-7,
            max(p[, ncol(p)]) < 1e-10,
            max(abs(drop(p %*% k^2) - mu^2 - compois()$variance(mu, phi))) < 1e-5)
  p
}

for (trait in traits) {
  set.seed(20261026 + match(trait, c("clutch", "fledging")))
  cat(trait, "prediction export\n"); flush.console()
  m <- readRDS(file.path(base, paste0(trait, "_within_between_selected.rds")))
  d <- readRDS(file.path(base, paste0(trait, "_analysis_data.rds")))
  stopifnot(m$fit$convergence == 0, isTRUE(m$sdr$pdHess), nobs(m) == nrow(d))
  b <- fixef(m)
  terms <- c(names(b$cond), paste0("disp~", names(b$disp)),
             if (length(b$zi)) paste0("zi~", names(b$zi)))
  V <- vcov(m, full = TRUE)[terms, terms, drop = FALSE]
  point <- c(unname(b$cond), unname(b$disp), unname(b$zi))
  stopifnot(min(eigen(V, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values) > 0)
  draws <- MASS::mvrnorm(4000, point, V)
  nc <- length(b$cond); nd <- length(b$disp)
  design <- if (trait == "clutch")
    ~ rel_LD + temp_within + temp_between + year_c + age_class else
    ~ rel_LD + age_class + temp_within + temp_between + year_c
  centre <- unique(round(d$temp_mean - d$temp_mean_c, 10))
  reference <- function(n) data.frame(
    rel_LD = 0, temp_within = rep(0, n), temp_between = 0, year_c = 0,
    age_class = factor(rep("YOUNG", n), levels = c("YOUNG", "OLD")))
  evaluate <- function(newdata) {
    X <- model.matrix(design, newdata)
    location <- drop(X %*% b$cond); scale <- drop(X %*% b$disp)
    locations <- X %*% t(draws[, seq_len(nc), drop = FALSE])
    scales <- X %*% t(draws[, nc + seq_len(nd), drop = FALSE])
    phi <- exp(scale); phis <- exp(scales)
    if (trait == "clutch") {
      mu <- exp(location); mus <- exp(locations)
      consistency <- sqrt(compois()$variance(mu, phi))
      consistencies <- matrix(sqrt(compois()$variance(as.vector(mus), as.vector(phis))),
                               nrow(newdata), nrow(draws))
    } else {
      zero <- plogis(b$zi[1]); zeros <- plogis(draws[, nc + nd + 1])
      mu <- (1 - zero) * plogis(location)
      mus <- sweep(plogis(locations), 2, 1 - zeros, "*")
      consistency <- phi; consistencies <- phis
    }
    native_data <- newdata; native_data$female_id <- NA; native_data$year_f <- NA
    native_mean <- predict(m, newdata = native_data, type = "response", re.form = NA,
                           allow.new.levels = TRUE)
    native_phi <- predict(m, newdata = native_data, type = "disp", re.form = NA,
                          allow.new.levels = TRUE)
    stopifnot(max(abs(native_mean - mu)) < 1e-7,
              max(abs(native_phi - phi)) < 1e-7)
    list(mean = mu, means = mus, consistency = consistency, consistencies = consistencies)
  }
  for (predictor in c("temp_within", "temp_between")) {
    range <- quantile(d[[predictor]], c(.05, .95))
    newdata <- reference(101)
    newdata[[predictor]] <- seq(range[1], range[2], length.out = 101)
    pred <- evaluate(newdata)
    for (component in c("mean", "consistency")) {
      values <- pred[[if (component == "mean") "means" else "consistencies"]]
      ci <- t(apply(values, 1, quantile, c(.025, .975)))
      all_curves[[paste(trait, predictor, component)]] <- data.frame(
        trait = trait, predictor = predictor, component = component,
        x = newdata[[predictor]] + if (predictor == "temp_between") centre else 0,
        estimate = pred[[component]], lower = ci[, 1], upper = ci[, 2])
    }
    contrast <- reference(2); contrast[[predictor]] <- c(0, 1)
    z <- evaluate(contrast)
    mean_change <- z$means[2, ] - z$means[1, ]
    ratio <- z$consistencies[2, ] / z$consistencies[1, ]
    all_effects[[paste(trait, predictor)]] <- data.frame(
      trait = trait, predictor = predictor,
      mean_change_per_C = z$mean[2] - z$mean[1],
      mean_lower = quantile(mean_change, .025), mean_upper = quantile(mean_change, .975),
      consistency_measure = if (trait == "clutch") "conditional_SD" else "component_precision",
      consistency_ratio_per_C = z$consistency[2] / z$consistency[1],
      ratio_lower = quantile(ratio, .025), ratio_upper = quantile(ratio, .975))
  }
  re <- VarCorr(m)
  random_sd[[trait]] <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(re), function(component)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(names(re[[component]]), function(group)
      data.frame(trait = trait, component = component, group = group,
                 SD = unname(attr(re[[component]][[group]], "stddev")))))))

  # Conditional plug-in checks at fitted group modes; no parameter uncertainty
  # or held-out assessment is implied by these simulation intervals.
  mu <- predict(m, type = if (trait == "clutch") "response" else "conditional")
  phi <- predict(m, type = "disp")
  statistic <- if (trait == "clutch") function(y)
    c(mean = mean(y), variance = var(y), fraction_six = mean(y == 6),
      outside_2_9 = mean(y < 2 | y > 9)) else function(y)
    c(mean_fraction = mean(y / d$clutch), variance_fraction = var(y / d$clutch),
      complete_failure = mean(y == 0), complete_success = mean(y == d$clutch))
  observed <- statistic(if (trait == "clutch") d$clutch else d$fledged)
  if (trait == "clutch") {
    pmf <- cmp_pmf(mu, phi)
    cdf <- t(apply(pmf, 1, cumsum))
    simulation <- replicate(300, statistic(rowSums(cdf < runif(nrow(d)))))
  } else {
    zero <- predict(m, type = "zprob")
    simulation <- replicate(300, {
      y <- rbinom(nrow(d), d$clutch, rbeta(nrow(d), mu * phi, (1 - mu) * phi))
      y[runif(nrow(d)) < zero] <- 0
      statistic(y)
    })
  }
  interval <- t(apply(simulation, 1, quantile, c(.025, .975)))
  all_checks[[trait]] <- data.frame(trait = trait, statistic = names(observed),
                                    observed = unname(observed), predicted = rowMeans(simulation),
                                    lower = interval[, 1], upper = interval[, 2], simulations = 300)
  put(do.call(rbind, all_curves), "prediction_curves.csv")
  put(do.call(rbind, all_effects), "reference_effects_per_degree.csv")
  put(do.call(rbind, random_sd), "random_effect_SD.csv")
  put(do.call(rbind, all_checks), "conditional_simulation_checks.csv")
  cat(trait, "export complete\n"); flush.console()
}

Main conclusions

Warmer springs: lower success; temperature association with precision uncertain.
Later laying: lower success and lower precision. Age differences remained uncertain.
Precision measures consistency at fixed component mean and clutch size; conditional simulation variance remained underestimated.

title: S6. Model structure and diagnostics
text:
Spring-temperature model
The environmental model is a Gaussian location–scale fit to the 46 annual mean temperatures. Calendar year enters both the mean and log standard deviation. This light model can be rerun in the browser from the public annual file:

Run RFit spring-temperature location and scale
Fits the Gaussian mean and log-SD likelihood to 46 annual temperatures. Coefficients for time are per decade; this is not a reproductive model.
Editable R code
d <- read.csv("data_derived/annual_main_window_temperature.csv")
t <- (d$year - mean(d$year))/10
y <- d$temp_mean
start <- lm(y ~ t)
# The same Gaussian location-scale likelihood, fitted using base R.
nll <- function(b) {
  mu <- b[1] + b[2] * t
  log_sd <- b[3] + b[4] * t
  sum(log_sd + 0.5 * ((y - mu) / exp(log_sd))^2 + log(2*pi)/2)
}
fit <- optim(c(coef(start), log(sqrt(mean(residuals(start)^2))), 0),
             nll, method = "BFGS", hessian = TRUE,
             control = list(reltol = 1e-12, maxit = 2000))
stopifnot(fit$convergence == 0, min(eigen(fit$hessian, symmetric = TRUE)$values) > 0)
se <- sqrt(diag(solve(fit$hessian)))
print(data.frame(term = c("mean_intercept", "warming_per_decade", "log_SD_intercept", "log_SD_per_decade"),
  estimate = fit$par, lower = fit$par - qnorm(.975)*se, upper = fit$par + qnorm(.975)*se), row.names = FALSE)

title: S1. Sliding-window analysis
text:
Candidate-window calculation
The browser step below rebuilds the eligible-window search from the public daily temperature and annual laying-date inputs, then compares its selected window with the saved result. It also runs 500 independent randomisations. This can take longer than the input check; nothing runs until you press Run code.

Run RRecalculate the sliding-window search
Fits the eligible linear-window search from the daily data, then runs 500 new randomised searches. Base R; no individual bird records are needed.
Editable R code
annual <- read.csv("data_derived/annual_raw_median_laying_date.csv")
daily <- read.csv("data_derived/smhi_hoburg_daily_temperature.csv")
saved <- read.csv("tables/climwin_recovered/selected_windows_audit.csv")
daily$date <- as.Date(daily$date)
daily$week <- (as.integer(format(daily$date, "%j")) - 1L) %/% 7L
windows <- subset(expand.grid(open = 0:17, close = 0:17), open - close >= 2)
exposure <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(annual), nrow(windows))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(annual))) {
  y <- annual$year[i]
  w <- subset(daily, year == y)
  ref <- (as.integer(format(as.Date(sprintf("%d-05-07", y)), "%j")) - 1L) %/% 7L
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(windows))) {
    keep <- w$week >= ref - windows$open[j] & w$week <= ref - windows$close[j]
    stopifnot(sum(keep) == 7 * (windows$open[j] - windows$close[j] + 1))
    exposure[i, j] <- mean(w$temperature[keep])
  }
}
# Gaussian linear-model AICc: intercept+slope+residual SD = 3 parameters;
# the intercept-only comparison has 2 parameters.
n <- nrow(annual)
X <- scale(exposure)
y <- as.numeric(scale(annual$median_LD))
r <- drop(crossprod(X, y)) / (n - 1)
delta <- n * log1p(-pmin(r^2, 1 - 1e-15)) + 2 + 24/(n-4) - 12/(n-3)
best <- which.min(delta)
fit <- lm(annual$median_LD ~ exposure[, best])
answer <- data.frame(open_weeks = windows$open[best], close_weeks = windows$close[best],
                     delta_AICc = delta[best], temperature_beta = coef(fit)[2])
stopifnot(answer$open_weeks == saved$open_weeks[1],
          answer$close_weeks == saved$close_weeks[1],
          abs(answer$delta_AICc - saved$delta_AICc[1]) < 1e-5,
          abs(answer$temperature_beta - saved$temperature_beta[1]) < 1e-7)
print(answer, row.names = FALSE)
# Re-run complete eligible-window searches under randomisation.
# This is a new reproducible set of shuffles, not a replay of saved shuffles.
set.seed(20261027)
B <- 500L
permuted <- replicate(B, sample(y))
correlations <- crossprod(X, permuted) / (n - 1)
null <- n * log1p(-apply(correlations^2, 2, max)) + 2 + 24/(n-4) - 12/(n-3)
cat("Eligible windows:", nrow(windows), "\nRandomised full searches:", B,
    "\nExceedances:", sum(null <= delta[best]),
    "\nPlus-one p:", (1 + sum(null <= delta[best]))/(B + 1), "\n")

text:
Full fitting script
The historical climwin script below includes preprocessing of the original field archive, which is outside this model-ready data release. For a standalone window search, the public-data runner uses the 45 annual laying-date summaries and daily weather observations to reconstruct the eligible-window calculation and run 500 independent randomisations. Original cached searches remain available separately.


Show full climwin script



R/04_climwin_laying_date.R

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

.libPaths(c("../../repo_gotland_flycatcher_phenology/.r-lib",
            "../../repo_gotland_flycatcher_phenology/Rlib", .libPaths()))

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(climwin)
})

# Force English month abbreviations/names in all exported calendar labels.
Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C")

dir.create("models/climwin", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("tables", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Fixed, preregistered analysis settings.
set.seed(20260808)
search_range <- c(17, 0)

birds_all <- read_csv(
  "data_raw/birds/DB_MISMATCH_current_onset_1980-2025.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  transmute(
    year = as.integer(YEAR),
    lay_date = as.numeric(LD),
    laying_calendar = as.Date(laying_date, format = "%d/%m/%Y")
  ) |>
  filter(year >= 1980, year <= 2025, !is.na(laying_calendar)) |>
  mutate(lay_date_from_may = as.numeric(
    laying_calendar - as.Date(sprintf("%d-05-01", year))
  ))

stopifnot(all(between(birds_all$lay_date_from_may, -10, 60)))
stopifnot(all(birds_all$lay_date == birds_all$lay_date_from_may,
              na.rm = TRUE))

# The response uses every valid laying date. Age is retained in the raw source
# but is not used to filter or adjust the annual population median.
annual <- birds_all |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    n_broods = n(),
    median_LD = median(lay_date_from_may),
    p05_lay_from_may = as.numeric(quantile(lay_date_from_may, 0.05,
                                           names = FALSE, type = 7)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(year) |>
  mutate(
    season_index = row_number(),
    bdate = as.Date(sprintf("%d-05-01", year)) + round(median_LD),
    p05_lay_calendar = as.Date(sprintf("%d-05-01", year)) + p05_lay_from_may
  )

expected_years <- c(1980:2019, 2021:2025)
stopifnot(nrow(annual) == 45L, identical(annual$year, expected_years))
n_first <- 23L

temperature <- read_csv("data_derived/smhi_hoburg_daily_temperature.csv",
                               show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  transmute(date = as.Date(date), temperature = as.numeric(temperature)) |>
  filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(temperature))

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(temperature$date))
stopifnot(all(diff(temperature$date) == 1))

# Keep the descriptive population median separate from the fixed reference day
# used to anchor all absolute climate windows.
ref_ld <- median(birds_all$lay_date)
refday <- c(7L, 5L)
ref_date_template <- as.Date("2001-05-07")

run_sliding <- function(dat) {
  baseline <- lm(median_LD ~ 1, data = dat)
  slidingwin(
    xvar = list(temperature = temperature$temperature),
    cdate = temperature$date,
    bdate = dat$bdate,
    baseline = baseline,
    type = "absolute",
    refday = refday,
    range = search_range,
    stat = "mean",
    func = "lin",
    cinterval = "week"
  )
}

run_random <- function(dat, repeats = 500L) {
  baseline <- lm(median_LD ~ 1, data = dat)
  randwin(
    repeats = repeats,
    xvar = list(temperature = temperature$temperature),
    cdate = temperature$date,
    bdate = dat$bdate,
    baseline = baseline,
    type = "absolute",
    refday = refday,
    range = search_range,
    stat = "mean",
    func = "lin",
    cinterval = "week"
  )
}

main_win <- run_sliding(annual)
first_win <- run_sliding(filter(annual, season_index <= n_first))
second_win <- run_sliding(filter(annual, season_index > n_first))

saveRDS(main_win, "models/climwin/slidingwin_main_calendar_index_ref07may_range17w.rds")
saveRDS(first_win, "models/climwin/slidingwin_first23_calendar_index_ref07may_range17w.rds")
saveRDS(second_win, "models/climwin/slidingwin_second22_calendar_index_ref07may_range17w.rds")

# This is intentionally expensive and is cached as an RDS object.
rand_path <- "models/climwin/randwin_main_calendar_index_ref07may_range17w_500.rds"
if (file.exists(rand_path)) {
  main_rand <- readRDS(rand_path)
} else {
  main_rand <- run_random(annual, repeats = 500L)
  saveRDS(main_rand, rand_path)
}

stopifnot(nrow(main_rand[[1]]) == 500L)

main_dataset <- main_win[[1]]$Dataset
first_dataset <- first_win[[1]]$Dataset
second_dataset <- second_win[[1]]$Dataset

best_row <- function(x, minimum_length_weeks = 0) {
  x |>
    filter(WindowOpen - WindowClose >= minimum_length_weeks) |>
    slice_min(deltaAICc, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
}
main_best <- best_row(main_dataset, minimum_length_weeks = 2)
first_best <- best_row(first_dataset, minimum_length_weeks = 2)
second_best <- best_row(second_dataset, minimum_length_weeks = 2)

# Both false-positive diagnostics required by climwin.
p_delta_aicc <- pvalue(main_dataset, main_rand[[1]], metric = "AIC",
                       sample.size = nrow(annual))
p_c <- pvalue(main_dataset, main_rand[[1]], metric = "C",
              sample.size = nrow(annual))

main_med <- medwin(main_dataset, cw = 0.95)

calendar_label <- function(days_before) {
  format(ref_date_template - as.integer(round(days_before)), "%d %b")
}

window_row <- function(label, best, years) {
  tibble(
    analysis = label,
    years = years,
    window_open_weeks_before_refday = best$WindowOpen,
    window_close_weeks_before_refday = best$WindowClose,
    boundary_difference_weeks = best$WindowOpen - best$WindowClose,
    window_open_days_before_refday = best$WindowOpen * 7,
    window_close_days_before_refday = best$WindowClose * 7,
    window_open_calendar = calendar_label(best$WindowOpen * 7),
    window_close_calendar = calendar_label(best$WindowClose * 7),
    delta_AICc = best$deltaAICc
  )
}

windows <- bind_rows(
  window_row("Main", main_best, "1980-2025 (no 2020)"),
  window_row("First 23 seasons", first_best, "1980-2002"),
  window_row("Remaining 22 seasons", second_best, "2003-2025 (no 2020)")
)

# Out-of-sample evaluation: singlewin applies exactly the same weekly
# aggregation as the training slidingwin, without a new window search.
test_data <- annual |>
  filter(season_index > n_first)

oos_win <- singlewin(
  xvar = list(temperature = temperature$temperature),
  cdate = temperature$date,
  bdate = test_data$bdate,
  baseline = lm(median_LD ~ 1, data = test_data),
  type = "absolute",
  refday = refday,
  range = c(first_best$WindowOpen, first_best$WindowClose),
  stat = "mean",
  func = "lin",
  cinterval = "week"
  )

oos_model <- oos_win$BestModel
oos_summary <- summary(oos_model)
oos_coef <- coef(oos_summary)["climate", ]
oos <- tibble(
  training_years = "1980-2002 (23 seasons)",
  test_years = "2003-2025 (22 seasons; no 2020)",
  selected_open_days_before_refday = first_best$WindowOpen * 7,
  selected_close_days_before_refday = first_best$WindowClose * 7,
  temperature_beta = unname(oos_coef["Estimate"]),
  temperature_SE = unname(oos_coef["Std. Error"]),
  temperature_CI_low = temperature_beta - 1.96 * temperature_SE,
  temperature_CI_high = temperature_beta + 1.96 * temperature_SE,
  test_R_squared = oos_summary$r.squared,
  test_p = coef(oos_summary)["climate", "Pr(>|t|)"]
)

# medwin returns the median opening and closing boundaries of the 95% model set.
med_values <- as.numeric(unlist(main_med)) * 7
med_result <- tibble(
  confidence_set = "95%",
  median_window_open = med_values[1],
  median_window_close = med_values[2],
  median_open_calendar = calendar_label(med_values[1]),
  median_close_calendar = calendar_label(med_values[2])
)

false_positive <- tibble(
  randwin_repeats = 500L,
  P_delta_AICc = as.character(p_delta_aicc),
  P_c = as.numeric(p_c)
)

effect_row_from_model <- function(analysis, model) {
  cf <- coef(summary(model))["climate", ]
  tibble(
    analysis = analysis,
    temperature_beta = unname(cf["Estimate"]),
    temperature_SE = unname(cf["Std. Error"]),
    temperature_CI_low = temperature_beta - 1.96 * temperature_SE,
    temperature_CI_high = temperature_beta + 1.96 * temperature_SE,
    p = unname(cf["Pr(>|t|)"])
  )
}

effect_row_from_dataset <- function(analysis, best) {
  beta <- best$ModelBeta
  se <- best$Std.Error
  t_value <- beta / se
  tibble(
    analysis = analysis,
    temperature_beta = beta,
    temperature_SE = se,
    temperature_CI_low = beta - 1.96 * se,
    temperature_CI_high = beta + 1.96 * se,
    p = 2 * pt(abs(t_value), df = best$sample.size - 2, lower.tail = FALSE)
  )
}

temperature_effects <- bind_rows(
  effect_row_from_dataset("Main: full dataset window", main_best),
  effect_row_from_dataset("First 23 seasons: selected window", first_best),
  effect_row_from_dataset("Remaining 22 seasons: selected window", second_best),
  effect_row_from_model("OOS: first-period window tested in remaining seasons", oos_model)
)

main_close <- as.integer(main_best$WindowClose) * 7
overlap_check <- annual |>
  mutate(
    window_close_calendar = as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-%02d", year,
                                             refday[2], refday[1])) - main_close,
    window_reaches_p05_lay = window_close_calendar >= p05_lay_calendar
  ) |>
  select(year, n_broods, p05_lay_from_may, p05_lay_calendar,
         window_close_calendar, window_reaches_p05_lay)

  setting = c("analysis level", "analysis years", "response", "age filtering or adjustment",
              "minimum window length in all window selections",
              "type", "reference laying date (database LD index; LD = 0 is 1 May)",
              "reference calendar day", "range",
              "stat", "func", "cinterval", "baseline", "randwin repeats"),

            as.character(ref_ld), format(ref_date_template, "%d %B"),
            "17 to 0 weeks (119 to 0 days)",
            "mean", "lin", "week", "median_LD ~ 1", "500")

text:
Temporal-validation check
The archived singlewin call used a different exposure series and returned +0.370 days/°C. The separate audit below reconstructs the complete-week bins and verifies the main, training and second-period slopes against the cached search output before evaluating the held-out years. It does not repeat the search.


Show recovery audit code: weekly bins, cached checks and held-out validation



R/04a_audit_recovered_climwin.R

# Recovery audit, added 26 October 2026. This is separate from the unchanged
# historical script R/04_climwin_laying_date.R. It does not repeat a window
# search or randomisation. It reads aggregate caches and fits three small LMs.
# Run from the publication repository root with base R (no extra packages).

cache <- readRDS("cache/climwin/recovered_search_data.rds")
annual <- read.csv("data_derived/annual_raw_median_laying_date.csv")
daily <- read.csv("data_derived/smhi_hoburg_daily_temperature.csv")
daily$date <- as.Date(daily$date)
stopifnot(nrow(annual) == 45L, !anyDuplicated(daily$date),
          all(diff(daily$date) == 1), nrow(cache$randomised) == 500L)
out <- "tables/climwin_recovered"
dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
put <- function(x, name) write.csv(x, file.path(out, name), row.names = FALSE)

best_row <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x$WindowOpen - x$WindowClose >= 2, , drop = FALSE]
  x[which.min(x$deltaAICc), , drop = FALSE]
}
best <- lapply(cache[c("main", "first23", "second22")],
               function(x) best_row(x$Dataset))

# Recover complete-week exposure without installing climwin. In these cached
# searches the seven-day bins start on 1 January of each calendar year.
daily_year <- as.integer(format(daily$date, "%Y"))
daily_week <- (as.integer(format(daily$date, "%j")) - 1L) %/% 7L
exposure <- function(y, open, close) {
  ref <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-05-07", y))
  ref_week <- (as.integer(format(ref, "%j")) - 1L) %/% 7L
  keep <- daily_year == y & daily_week >= ref_week - open &
    daily_week <= ref_week - close
  stopifnot(sum(keep) == (open - close + 1L) * 7L)
  data.frame(year = y, climate = mean(daily$temperature[keep]),
             first_date = min(daily$date[keep]), last_date = max(daily$date[keep]),
             n_days = sum(keep))
}
window_exposure <- function(b, years = annual$year) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(years, exposure,
                       open = b$WindowOpen, close = b$WindowClose))
}

selection <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(best), function(label) {
  b <- best[[label]]
  ordinary <- window_exposure(b, 1981L)
  leap <- window_exposure(b, 1980L)
  data.frame(analysis = label, open_weeks = b$WindowOpen,
             close_weeks = b$WindowClose, delta_AICc = b$deltaAICc,
             temperature_beta = b$ModelBeta, SE = b$Std.Error,
             non_leap_start = format(ordinary$first_date, "%d %b"),
             non_leap_end = format(ordinary$last_date, "%d %b"),
             leap_start = format(leap$first_date, "%d %b"),
             leap_end = format(leap$last_date, "%d %b"),
             n_days = ordinary$n_days)
}))
put(selection, "selected_windows_audit.csv")
put(cache$main$Dataset, "candidate_windows.csv")
put(cache$randomised, "randomised_windows.csv")

null <- cache$randomised$deltaAICc
observed <- best$main$deltaAICc
exceed <- sum(null <= observed)
randomisation <- data.frame(
  observed_delta_AICc = observed, repeats = length(null),
  exceedances = exceed, plus_one_p = (exceed + 1) / (length(null) + 1),
  null_min = min(null), null_max = max(null))
put(randomisation, "randomisation_audit.csv")
stopifnot(exceed == 0L, abs(observed + 38.60159858397057) < 1e-8)

main_exposure <- window_exposure(best$main)
training_window <- window_exposure(best$first23)
second_exposure <- window_exposure(best$second22)
annual$main_climate <- main_exposure$climate
annual$climate <- training_window$climate
annual$week_start <- training_window$first_date
annual$week_end <- training_window$last_date
annual$week_n_days <- training_window$n_days
annual$partition <- ifelse(annual$year <= 2002, "training", "held_out")
put(annual, "annual_weekly_exposure.csv")

main_fit <- lm(median_LD ~ main_climate, data = annual)
train <- subset(annual, year <= 2002)
test <- subset(annual, year >= 2003)
training_fit <- lm(median_LD ~ climate, data = train)
held_out_fit <- lm(median_LD ~ climate, data = test)
second <- subset(annual, year >= 2003)
second$climate <- second_exposure$climate[annual$year >= 2003]
second_fit <- lm(median_LD ~ climate, data = second)

# These agreements verify the bin reconstruction against the original search
# output, rather than assuming that a similar-looking daily window is enough.
stopifnot(abs(coef(main_fit)[2] - best$main$ModelBeta) < 1e-10,
          abs(coef(training_fit)[2] - best$first23$ModelBeta) < 1e-10,
          abs(coef(second_fit)[2] - best$second22$ModelBeta) < 1e-10)
aicc <- function(m) {
  k <- attr(logLik(m), "df"); n <- nobs(m)
  AIC(m) + 2 * k * (k + 1) / (n - k - 1)
}
reconstructed_delta <- aicc(main_fit) - aicc(lm(median_LD ~ 1, annual))
stopifnot(abs(reconstructed_delta - observed) < 1e-8)

ci <- confint(held_out_fit)["climate", ]
predicted <- predict(training_fit, newdata = test)
legacy <- cache$legacy_singlewin
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(legacy$model_data$yvar),
                          as.numeric(test$median_LD))))
validation <- data.frame(
  training_seasons = nrow(train), held_out_seasons = nrow(test),
  training_beta = unname(coef(training_fit)[2]),
  held_out_beta = unname(coef(held_out_fit)[2]),
  held_out_CI_low = ci[1], held_out_CI_high = ci[2],
  held_out_R_squared = summary(held_out_fit)$r.squared,
  held_out_p = coef(summary(held_out_fit))["climate", "Pr(>|t|)"],
  prediction_RMSE = sqrt(mean((predicted - test$median_LD)^2)),
  baseline_RMSE = sqrt(mean((mean(train$median_LD) - test$median_LD)^2)),
  prediction_bias = mean(predicted - test$median_LD),
  legacy_singlewin_beta = unname(legacy$coefficients["climate"]),
  max_legacy_exposure_difference = max(abs(legacy$model_data$climate - test$climate)))
rownames(validation) <- NULL
put(validation, "temporal_validation_audit.csv")
put(data.frame(year = test$year, median_LD = test$median_LD,
               complete_week_climate = test$climate,
               legacy_singlewin_climate = legacy$model_data$climate),
    "legacy_exposure_comparison.csv")
stopifnot(abs(validation$held_out_beta + 1.565527) < 1e-6,
          abs(validation$prediction_RMSE - 3.186713) < 1e-6)

             temporal_validation = validation),
        "cache/climwin/recovery_audit_results.rds", version = 3)

title: Overview
text:
Study objectives


Using long-term individual-based records of collared flycatchers (Ficedula albicollis) breeding in nest boxes on Gotland, Sweden, we examined:

Temporal changes in mean spring temperature and its interannual variability.
Calendar-year changes in mean reproductive performance and reproductive consistency, assessed using clutch size and egg-to-fledging success.
Associations of spring temperature with mean reproductive performance and reproductive consistency.
Differences between within-female and among-female temperature associations with both mean reproductive performance and reproductive consistency.
Associations of relative laying date and female age class (yearling versus older) with these reproductive traits.


Data origin and source database: long-term Gotland breeding monitoring, the source GitHub database and SMHI weather observations.

title: A1. Data and reproduction workflow
text:
The breeding records originated from the long-term nest-box monitoring of collared flycatchers (Ficedula albicollis) on Gotland, Sweden, established in 1980. Individually ringed females were linked to records of laying date, clutch size, fledgling number and female age class.


The source breeding dataset for this analysis lineage is CF21980-2025.csv, containing 15,984 records from seasons spanning 1980–2025. View the CF source dataset on GitHub · Source-file documentation and checksum.
This is an unchanged copy of the file uploaded to the phenology repository on 28 January 2026. The CSV uses a semicolon delimiter. Its 14,693 records from 1980–2019 agree in the checked analysis variables (LD, CS, HS, FLEDGE, NEWRECRUIT and FAGE_CAT) with the sheet Corrected for CS,FL,NEWR in CF_non-exp_breeding_events_1980-2019_RM_28.01.26.xlsx. The file also contains records from later seasons.



The data lineage was CF21980-2025.csv → DB_MISMATCH.csv → the local derivative DB_MISMATCH_current_onset_1980-2025.csv → the final trait-specific model-ready files. A comparison of the saved Git versions found no changes to FLEDGE from the January source through these later versions. The DB_MISMATCH filenames reflect the earlier phenology project; NDVI and mismatch were not predictors in the final reproductive models reported here.
The original source upload contains incomplete records, which were retained in the archive. For 2025, 198 records have LD observed and 179 records enter the final clutch-size sample. FLEDGE is missing for 2025; the reported fledging sample covers 1981–2019.



CF_adult_birds_1980-2019.csv is an earlier archive of 23,911 field records, consistent in the checked breeding fields with RM_CF_adults_1980-2019_14.07.23.xlsx. It is retained for provenance, rather than identified as the source version used to prepare the present models.
Compared with that earlier archive, 14,692 unambiguously matched records contain 312 FLEDGE differences: 247 missing-to-observed, 57 observed-to-different-observed and eight observed-to-missing. The 247 populated values and 57 revised counts were already present in the updated workbook dated 23 January 2026. Of the eight later missing values, one was already missing in that workbook and seven resulted from the documented January selection/correction stage. The corrected sheet documents 14 FLEDGE values cleared because the fledgling count was below the recruit count. The underlying field-log basis of the January 2026 updates is not documented in the available files.



The final models were fitted to the curated, trait-specific samples derived during preparation of the later breeding dataset. Original ring labels were replaced with consistent model-only female identifiers in the public model-ready files.

The runner checks the model samples, refits the environmental model, repeats the eligible-window search with 500 independent randomisations, fits the baseline and within–between reproductive models, fits the separate temporal models, and exports contrasts, curves and conditional simulation checks. Regenerated figures are written under figures/reproduced/. It compares regenerated reproductive coefficients with the published exports. Published coefficients are numerical starting values; likelihood optimisation and convergence checks are rerun. No historical fitted-model object is needed.
Model checkpoints are written under models/; regenerated numerical results are stored under tables/reproduced/ and tables/within_between_20261026_reproduced/. Original publication exports are retained. Stages can also be run separately, for example Rscript R/94_reproduce_from_public_data.R inputs environment windows. The available stages are inputs, environment, windows, models, temporal, exports, figures and verify. The main mixed-model fits can take substantial time; checkpoints allow completed optimisations to be reused.
The browser controls remain lightweight checks and calculations. Full mixed-model refitting uses local R, not the browser. Historical scripts that refer to earlier private paths are retained as provenance; use the standalone runner for a clean refit.
The public files begin at the final curated analysis samples, not at the raw field-data cleaning stage. The phenology-window analysis uses public annual laying-date summaries for 45 seasons, rather than the trait-specific reproductive samples. The original 500 randomised searches remain in the public cache; independent randomisations reproduce the procedure, not the exact historical permutations.
Weather covers 1980–2025 (46 seasons), the sliding-window laying-date series covers 45 seasons, clutch-size data cover 12,627 breeding attempts from 8,894 females (1981–2025, excluding 2020), and fledging data cover 9,790 attempts from 7,132 females (1981–2019).

section: Fit and verify the single-temperature model
text:
Fit and verify the single-temperature model
COM-Poisson location and dispersion use laying date, temperature, year and age. Female and year random intercepts enter location.


Historical verification code (provenance)



R/75_verify_COM_Poisson.R

.libPaths(c(path.expand('~/R/cf_model_comparison_20261013_R46'),path.expand('~/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.5'),.libPaths()))
library(glmmTMB)
out<-'glmmTMB_comparison_20261016/clutch_counts';d<-readRDS(file.path(out,'data.rds'))
m<-readRDS(file.path(out,'COM_predictors_bounded.rds'));pl<-m$obj$env$parList(par=m$fit$parfull);st<-pl[c('beta','betadisp','theta','b')]
lo<-c(1.6,-.03,-.08,-.008,-.15,-5,rep(-.5,4),rep(-10,2));hi<-c(2,.01,.08,.008,.15,0,rep(.5,4),rep(0,2));sc<-c(1,100,10,200,10,1,100,10,200,10,1,1)
a<-glmmTMB(clutch~rel_LD+temp_mean_c+year_c+age_class+(1|female_id)+(1|year_f),dispformula=~rel_LD+temp_mean_c+year_c+age_class,family=compois(),data=d,start=st,control=glmmTMBControl(optimizer=optim,optArgs=list(method='L-BFGS-B',lower=lo,upper=hi),optCtrl=list(maxit=1000,factr=1e4,parscale=1/sc),parallel=1))
saveRDS(a,file.path(out,'COM_predictors_verified.rds'))
dd<-do.call(rbind,lapply(list(nlminb=m,LBFGS=a),function(x)data.frame(code=x$fit$convergence,pdHess=x$sdr$pdHess,logLik=as.numeric(logLik(x)),scaled_gradient=max(abs(x$sdr$gradient.fixed*sqrt(diag(x$sdr$cov.fixed)))),bound_distance=min(pmin(x$fit$par-lo,hi-x$fit$par)/(hi-lo)))))
print(dd);write.csv(dd,file.path(out,'COM_final_diagnostics.csv'))
stopifnot(all(dd$code==0),all(dd$pdHess),all(dd$bound_distance>.01),all(dd$scaled_gradient<.002),abs(diff(dd$logLik))<.01)
file.copy(file.path(out,'COM_selected.rds'),file.path(out,'COM_year_selected_for_audit.rds'),overwrite=TRUE)
saveRDS(if(logLik(a)>logLik(m))a else m,file.path(out,'COM_selected.rds'))
writeLines('Selected COM model has covariate-dependent dispersion without a year dispersion random effect; attempted full year-dispersion fit reached SD exp(-10), with negligible likelihood improvement. This is a sensitivity model, not an exactly matched random-effect structure.',file.path(out,'COM_selection.txt'))

R/76_export_COM_predictions.R

.libPaths(c(path.expand('~/R/cf_model_comparison_20261013_R46'),path.expand('~/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.5'),.libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(glmmTMB);library(MASS)})
base<-'glmmTMB_comparison_20261016/clutch_counts'
out<-file.path(base,'primary_export');dir.create(out,showWarnings=FALSE)
m<-readRDS(file.path(base,'COM_selected.rds'));d<-m$frame
capture.output(sessionInfo(),file=file.path(out,'session_info.txt'))
set.seed(20261019)
ix<-which(names(m$fit$par)%in%c('beta','betadisp'))
bb<-MASS::mvrnorm(4000,m$fit$par[ix],m$sdr$cov.fixed[ix,ix])
summ<-function(z,est)data.frame(estimate=est,CI_low=apply(z,1,quantile,.025),CI_high=apply(z,1,quantile,.975))
cent<-read.csv('/home/arct/CF_thermal_phenology_run/data_derived/clutch_size_model_data.csv')
tc<-unique(round(cent$temp_mean-cent$temp_mean_c,10));yc<-unique(round(as.numeric(as.character(d$year_f))-d$year_c,10))
stopifnot(length(tc)==1,length(yc)==1)
for(kind in c('temperature','date','year','age')){
 n<-if(kind=='age')2 else if(kind=='year')45 else 120
 nd<-d[rep(1,n),];nd$rel_LD<-0;nd$temp_mean_c<-0;nd$year_c<-0
 nd$age_class<-factor(rep(levels(d$age_class)[1],n),levels=levels(d$age_class))
 if(kind=='temperature'){nd$temp_mean_c<-seq(quantile(d$temp_mean_c,.05),quantile(d$temp_mean_c,.95),length.out=n);xx<-nd$temp_mean_c+tc}
 if(kind=='date'){nd$rel_LD<-seq(quantile(d$rel_LD,.05),quantile(d$rel_LD,.95),length.out=n);xx<-nd$rel_LD}
 if(kind=='year'){xx<-1981:2025;nd$year_c<-xx-yc}
 if(kind=='age'){nd$age_class<-factor(levels(d$age_class),levels=levels(d$age_class));xx<-1:2}
 X<-model.matrix(~rel_LD+temp_mean_c+year_c+age_class,nd)
 mu<-exp(X%*%t(bb[,1:5]));psi<-exp(X%*%t(bb[,6:10]))
 sd<-matrix(sqrt(compois()$variance(as.vector(mu),as.vector(psi))),n,4000)
 em<-exp(drop(X%*%fixef(m)$cond));ep<-exp(drop(X%*%fixef(m)$disp));es<-sqrt(compois()$variance(em,ep))
 for(comp in c('mean','sd'))write.csv(cbind(x=xx,age_class=nd$age_class,summ(if(comp=='mean')mu else sd,if(comp=='mean')em else es)),file.path(out,paste0(kind,'_',comp,'.csv')),row.names=FALSE)
}
write.csv(data.frame(temperature_center=tc,year_center=yc),file.path(out,'centering.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
writeLines('Primary COM-Poisson curves: ML point estimates, joint asymptotic 95% CIs, exact conditional SD, zero random effects.',file.path(out,'COMPLETE.txt'))

text:
Main conclusions

Warmer springs: larger clutches; association with clutch-size consistency uncertain.
Later laying: smaller and more variable clutches. Older females: larger and more consistent clutches.
COM-Poisson improved on Poisson, but conditional variance and some count frequencies remained imperfectly reproduced.

diagrow <- function(m,trait,label,reference=NULL) {
 V<-if(is.null(m$sdr))reference$sdr$cov.fixed else m$sdr$cov.fixed
 gr<-if(is.null(m$sdr))m$obj$gr(m$fit$par) else m$sdr$gradient.fixed
 data.frame(trait=trait,model=label,n=nobs(m),df=attr(logLik(m),'df'),logLik=as.numeric(logLik(m)),AIC=AIC(m),convergence=m$fit$convergence,pdHess=if(is.null(m$sdr))NA else m$sdr$pdHess,scaled_gradient=max(abs(gr*sqrt(diag(V)))))
}
good <- function(m) m$fit$convergence==0 && isTRUE(m$sdr$pdHess) && is.finite(as.numeric(logLik(m))) && max(abs(m$sdr$gradient.fixed*sqrt(diag(m$sdr$cov.fixed))))<.005
whitened <- function(par,fn,gr,control=list(),...) {
 msg('Using baseline covariance for optimizer coordinate scaling')
 # Dropping the two temperature coefficients gives a positive-definite
 # numerical scaling matrix. This changes step coordinates, not likelihood,
 # priors or coefficient constraints, and avoids a costly numerical Hessian.
 V<-initial_covariance;stopifnot(nrow(V)==length(par),all(is.finite(V)))
 ee<-eigen((V+t(V))/2,symmetric=TRUE);stopifnot(min(ee$values)>0)
 S<-ee$vectors%*%diag(sqrt(ee$values));initial<-par
 if(trait=='clutch') {
  inner<-environment(fn)$inner.control;inner$maxit<-100L;inner$grad.tol<-1e-7
  environment(fn)$inner.control<-inner
 }
 ff<-function(q)fn(drop(initial+S%*%q));gg<-function(q)drop(crossprod(S,gr(drop(initial+S%*%q))))
 z<-optim(rep(0,length(par)),ff,gg,method='BFGS',control=list(maxit=1000,reltol=1e-12,trace=1,REPORT=5))
 list(par=drop(initial+S%*%z$par),objective=z$value,convergence=z$convergence,message=z$message)
}
all_diag <- list();all_fixed <- list();all_trend <- list();all_annual <- list();all_curves <- list()
for(trait in names(paths)) {
 msg('START',trait)
 old <- readRDS(paths[trait])
 d <- readRDS(file.path(fit_base,paste0(trait,'_analysis_data.rds')))
 stopifnot(nobs(old)==nrow(d))
 cf <- fixef(old);pl <- old$obj$env$parList(par=old$fit$parfull)
 # glmmTMB stores fixed parameters in beta, betazi, betadisp order.
 # Custom optimisers may omit names on fit$par, so use component lengths.
 remove <- c(match('temp_mean_c',names(cf$cond)),
             length(cf$cond)+length(cf$zi)+match('temp_mean_c',names(cf$disp)))
 initial_covariance <- old$sdr$cov.fixed[-remove,-remove,drop=FALSE]
 st <- pl[intersect(c('beta','betadisp','betazi','theta','thetadisp','thetazi','b','bdisp','bzi'),names(pl))]
 st <- st[vapply(st,length,integer(1))>0]
 st$beta <- unname(cf$cond[names(cf$cond)!='temp_mean_c'])
 st$betadisp <- unname(cf$disp[names(cf$disp)!='temp_mean_c'])
 form <- if(trait=='clutch') clutch~rel_LD+year_c+age_class+(1|female_id)+(1|year_f) else cbind(fledged,clutch-fledged)~rel_LD+age_class+year_c+(1|female_id)+(1|year_f)
 disp <- if(trait=='clutch') ~rel_LD+year_c+age_class else ~rel_LD+age_class+year_c+(1|year_f)
 if(trait=='clutch') {
  lo<-c(1.6,-.03,-.008,-.15,-5,rep(-.5,3),rep(-10,2));hi<-c(2,.01,.008,.15,0,rep(.5,3),rep(0,2));ps<-c(1,.01,.005,.1,1,.01,.005,.1,1,1)
 } else {
  lo<-c(rep(-10,9),rep(-9,4));hi<-c(rep(10,9),rep(log(10),4));ps<-c(1,1/30,1,1/100,1,1,1/30,1,1/100,rep(1,4))
 }
 ctl <- glmmTMBControl(optimizer=optim,optArgs=list(method='L-BFGS-B',lower=lo,upper=hi),optCtrl=list(maxit=10000,factr=1e4,pgtol=1e-7,parscale=ps),parallel=1)
 ctl<-glmmTMBControl(optimizer=whitened,parallel=1)
 file_a<-file.path(out,paste0(trait,'_LBFGS.rds'))
 if(file.exists(file_a)) a<-readRDS(file_a) else {a<-update(old,formula=form,dispformula=disp,data=d,start=st,control=ctl);saveRDS(a,file_a)}
 print(diagrow(a,trait,'without_temperature_LBFGS'));msg('Bound distance',min(pmin(a$fit$par-lo,hi-a$fit$par)/(hi-lo)))
 pl2<-a$obj$env$parList(par=a$fit$parfull)
 st2<-pl2[intersect(c('beta','betadisp','betazi','theta','thetadisp','thetazi','b','bdisp','bzi'),names(pl2))];st2<-st2[vapply(st2,length,integer(1))>0]
 file_b<-file.path(out,paste0(trait,'_BFGS.rds'))
 msg('Independent optimizer check',trait)
 if(file.exists(file_b)) b<-readRDS(file_b) else {b<-update(a,data=d,start=st2,se=FALSE,control=glmmTMBControl(optimizer=optim,optArgs=list(method='BFGS'),optCtrl=list(maxit=10000,reltol=1e-12),parallel=1));saveRDS(b,file_b)}
 dg<-rbind(diagrow(old,trait,'with_temperature'),diagrow(a,trait,'without_temperature_LBFGS'),diagrow(b,trait,'without_temperature_BFGS',reference=a))
 print(dg,digits=10);put(dg,paste0(trait,'_diagnostics.csv'));all_diag[[trait]]<-dg
 stopifnot(good(a),b$fit$convergence==0,dg$scaled_gradient[3]<.005,abs(as.numeric(logLik(a)-logLik(b)))<.01)
 new<-a
 stopifnot(identical(model.response(model.frame(old)),model.response(model.frame(new))))
 saveRDS(new,file.path(out,paste0(trait,'_selected.rds')))
 for(label in c('with_temperature','without_temperature')) {
  m<-if(label=='with_temperature') old else new
  capture.output(summary(m),glmmTMB::diagnose(m),file=file.path(out,paste0(trait,'_',label,'_summary.txt')))
  co<-summary(m)$coefficients
  all_fixed[[paste(trait,label)]]<-do.call(rbind,lapply(names(co),function(cmp){v<-co[[cmp]];if(!length(v))return(NULL);data.frame(trait=trait,model=label,component=cmp,term=rownames(v),estimate=v[,1],SE=v[,2],lower=v[,1]-1.96*v[,2],upper=v[,1]+1.96*v[,2])}))
  cf<-fixef(m);nc<-length(cf$cond);nd<-length(cf$disp);nz<-length(cf$zi)
  bn<-c(names(cf$cond),paste0('disp~',names(cf$disp)),if(nz)paste0('zi~',names(cf$zi)))
  V<-vcov(m,full=TRUE)
  # glmmTMB full covariance uses component-prefixed names.
  if(!all(bn %in% colnames(V))) stop(paste('Unexpected covariance names:',paste(colnames(V),collapse=',')))
  V<-V[bn,bn,drop=FALSE];beta<-c(unname(cf$cond),unname(cf$disp),unname(cf$zi));set.seed(20261022)
  draws<-MASS::mvrnorm(6000,beta,V)
  yrs<-sort(unique(as.integer(as.character(d$year_f))));offset<-median(as.integer(as.character(d$year_f))-d$year_c)
  grid<-data.frame(year=yrs,year_c=yrs-offset)
  X<-matrix(0,nrow(grid),nc,dimnames=list(NULL,names(cf$cond)));X[,'(Intercept)']<-1;X[,'year_c']<-grid$year_c
  Z<-matrix(0,nrow(grid),nd,dimnames=list(NULL,names(cf$disp)));Z[,'(Intercept)']<-1;Z[,'year_c']<-grid$year_c
  mu<-if(trait=='clutch') exp(drop(X%*%cf$cond)) else plogis(drop(X%*%cf$cond))
  mud<-if(trait=='clutch') exp(X%*%t(draws[,seq_len(nc),drop=FALSE])) else plogis(X%*%t(draws[,seq_len(nc),drop=FALSE]))
  phi<-exp(drop(Z%*%cf$disp));phid<-exp(Z%*%t(draws[,nc+seq_len(nd),drop=FALSE]))
  if(trait=='fledging') {mu<-mu*(1-plogis(cf$zi[1]));mud<-sweep(mud,2,1-plogis(draws[,nc+nd+1]),'*')}
  loq<-function(x)apply(x,1,quantile,.025);hiq<-function(x)apply(x,1,quantile,.975)
  all_curves[[paste(trait,label)]]<-data.frame(trait=trait,model=label,year=yrs,mean=mu,mean_lower=loq(mud),mean_upper=hiq(mud),dispersion=phi,dispersion_lower=loq(phid),dispersion_upper=hiq(phid))
  diffdraw<-mud[nrow(grid),]-mud[1,];ratio<-phid[nrow(grid),]/phid[1,]
  all_trend[[paste(trait,label)]]<-data.frame(trait=trait,model=label,first_year=min(yrs),last_year=max(yrs),reference_year=offset,mean_first=mu[1],mean_last=tail(mu,1),mean_change=tail(mu,1)-mu[1],mean_change_lower=quantile(diffdraw,.025),mean_change_upper=quantile(diffdraw,.975),dispersion_ratio=tail(phi,1)/phi[1],dispersion_ratio_lower=quantile(ratio,.025),dispersion_ratio_upper=quantile(ratio,.975))
  if(trait=='clutch') {
   ii<-c(1,nrow(grid));sdp<-sqrt(compois()$variance(mu[ii],phi[ii]));sdd<-matrix(sqrt(compois()$variance(as.vector(mud[ii,]),as.vector(phid[ii,]))),2,ncol(mud));rr<-sdd[2,]/sdd[1,]
   all_trend[[paste(trait,label)]]$response_SD_ratio<-sdp[2]/sdp[1]
   all_trend[[paste(trait,label)]]$response_SD_ratio_lower<-quantile(rr,.025)
   all_trend[[paste(trait,label)]]$response_SD_ratio_upper<-quantile(rr,.975)
  } else {
   all_trend[[paste(trait,label)]]$response_SD_ratio<-NA
   all_trend[[paste(trait,label)]]$response_SD_ratio_lower<-NA
   all_trend[[paste(trait,label)]]$response_SD_ratio_upper<-NA
  }
 }

cmp_pmf<-function(mu,phi) {
 nu<-1/phi;k<-0:max(40,ceiling(max(mu)+20));lf<-lgamma(k+1)
 prob<-function(a){z<-outer(a,k)-outer(nu,lf);z<-exp(z-do.call(pmax,as.data.frame(z)));z/rowSums(z)}
 lo<-nu*log(pmax(mu-3,.001))-20;hi<-nu*log(mu+3)+20
 for(it in 1:65){mid<-(lo+hi)/2;p<-prob(mid);em<-drop(p%*%k);low<-em<mu;lo[low]<-mid[low];hi[!low]<-mid[!low]}
 p<-prob((lo+hi)/2);stopifnot(max(abs(drop(p%*%k)-mu))<1e-7,max(p[,length(k)])<1e-10)
 stopifnot(max(abs(drop(p%*%k^2)-mu^2-compois()$variance(mu,phi)))<1e-5)
 p
}

 V<-vcov(m,full=TRUE);bn<-c(names(cf$cond),paste0('disp~',names(cf$disp)),if(length(cf$zi))paste0('zi~',names(cf$zi)))
 set.seed(20261022);draw<-MASS::mvrnorm(6000,c(unname(cf$cond),unname(cf$disp),unname(cf$zi)),V[bn,bn])
 yr<-as.integer(as.character(d$year_f));centre<-unique(round(yr-d$year_c,8));stopifnot(length(centre)==1)
 grid<-seq(min(yr),max(yr));nc<-length(cf$cond);nd<-length(cf$disp)

 Z<-matrix(0,length(grid),nd,dimnames=list(NULL,names(cf$disp)));Z[,1]<-1;Z[,'year_c']<-grid-centre
 eta<-drop(X%*%cf$cond);etad<-X%*%t(draw[,seq_len(nc),drop=FALSE]);phi<-exp(drop(Z%*%cf$disp));phid<-exp(Z%*%t(draw[,nc+seq_len(nd),drop=FALSE]))
 if(trait=='clutch') {

  outputs<-list(mean=list(mu,mud),sd=list(sd,sdd))
 } else {

 }

 cat(trait,'conditional simulation checks: 500 datasets\n');flush.console();set.seed(20261022)
 cmu<-predict(m,type='conditional');cphi<-predict(m,type='disp')
 if(trait=='clutch') {
  pp<-cmp_pmf(cmu,cphi);u<-matrix(runif(nrow(d)*500),nrow(d),500);ymat<-matrix(0L,nrow(d),500);cp<-numeric(nrow(d))
  for(j in seq_len(ncol(pp)-1)){cp<-cp+pp[,j];ymat<-ymat+(u>cp)}
 } else {
  zi<-predict(m,type='zprob')
  ymat<-replicate(500,{pr<-rbeta(nrow(d),cmu*cphi,(1-cmu)*cphi);y<-rbinom(nrow(d),d$clutch,pr);y[runif(nrow(d))<zi]<-0;y})
 }
 obs<-model.response(model.frame(m));if(trait=='fledging'){obs<-obs[,1]/d$clutch;ymat<-ymat/d$clutch}else obs<-as.numeric(obs)
 groups<-c(list(overall=seq_along(obs)),split(seq_along(obs),yr))
 for(g in names(groups)){

 }

}
